currentLiveSharedRules.newEndSaveBinding: NEW: Overwhelming Grief, Charm Monster, Erase Emotion and Phantasmal Killer use affected regular-END saves, including an affected current turn, without extra-turn saves. Outside initiative their first END-only save is at application +6 seconds and then each six seconds. On entering initiative map the next unresolved save to the next actual regular END, retain completed saves and the original absolute maximum, and do not add an immediate transition save. For an owner-attached target, use its actual regular attached-phase end with the same END-only fallback/transition above, granting no actions. Dominate Person and Confusion instead use their shared behavior cycle and companion binding.
currentLiveSharedRules.newCompanionPulseBinding: NEW for Illusion Phantasmal Killer on an owner-attached companion: its periodic packet uses the beginning of the actual original-owner regular attached phase, after that phase’s required processing, under the same once-per-numbered-round exposure. It creates no independent START or other start-trigger event. If no actual phase exists, use only the six-second damage schedule and original deadline, granting no actions. Transition to a real phase maps the next unresolved pulse opportunity without replaying an initial or completed pulse. Its separately scheduled repeat save still follows the END-only bridge.
currentLiveSharedRules.DE4-GUARD-01: NEW scoped DE4-GUARD-01 amendment: Mark Omen, Fate Coin and Fate Reversal share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from any of these three spells, across all casters, coins, marks, Fate Reversal permissions and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these three spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use stable actor IDs then stable source/application IDs fixed before the original event, with the same stable tie-break for initiative ties. Only the first legal commitment spends its own actual mark, coin or Fate Reversal permission and any Reaction required by that source; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. This guard extension and the explicitly proposed DE4-RNG-05 digital mapping preserve each source's distinct replacement unit and eligibility. Mark Omen still replaces the caster's own marked-target attack d20 procedure with no additional Action or Reaction; Fate Coin still changes exactly one eligible engine RNG die component through its holder's actual Reaction and30-foot perceived-event interface; Fate Reversal still requires its own Reaction, pending permission, eligible complete attack/save/check d20 procedure and60-foot perceived-event interface. No class feature is added to this family merely because it changes a roll, and this amendment grants no new access to hidden dice or any source's otherwise ineligible roll. Apply DE4-RNG-05 in full; its player-information boundaries never grant hidden RNG access.
currentLiveSharedRules.DE4-SEAL-LOCI-02: NEW spell-specific proposal for Seal Vision only. In creature mode use the protected actual body; in area mode a body is protected when any actual portion is within the20ft sphere and has center LoE, and a discrete spatial magical expression is protected at its actual source-defined locus. No whole-plane, body-independent soul or remote caster concentration locus is inferred. For an ongoing body-target Divination buff/mark, suspend that target component while protected, preserve identity/deadline/history, and resume only a still-existing component when protection ends. For a pending personal Divination permission, an actually protected/suppressed holder cannot activate that permission. For a Divination-created Fate Coin inside the area, retain the actual same physical coin/HP/custody/deadline while disabling its magical reroll use; do not create material or destroy it merely from this spell suppression. Prevent an actually blocked new Divination component from establishing; no deferred component appears when protection later ends. For a reroll use whose own source remains operative, separately test the actual original roll-generating creature/object or source-defined local event. Protecting one recipient of an independently generated shared damage pool does not split or selectively reroll that pool, and ordinary indirect consequences retain their original source school. The original roll generator/event is fixed by the actual source before a reroll; it is not the rendered RNG animation position or a convenient alternative victim. If a source leaves that generator genuinely undefined, resolve and record that ambiguity before claiming a legal protected/unprotected example. Known non-operative permission is unusable without expenditure. An otherwise legal operative permission committed against a protected original roll event is spent under its real source and common guard, but its blocked Divination alteration produces no replacement; the unchanged original result resolves. This latter paid-block distinction is explicit NEW local authorship requiring joint review. No information-only ward becomes general antimagic.
currentLiveSharedRules.DE4-ORDER-DELIVERY-02: NEW scoped Dominate Person mental-order channel: a conscious controller can issue the one opportunity order only while controller and target are on the same actual plane. No additional maintained range or shared language/hearing is required; no perceptions/location/knowledge flow back. Protection against an actual information-gathering source does not by itself cancel this noninformational channel. A genuinely issued valid order retains its ordinary opportunity and exact expiry if the target is subsequently relocated; a later failed new issuance creates no replacement. This does not transport the target, permit an unsafe route or compel optional resource use. Dominate Person uses the future START/actual attached-phase opportunity, so it does not grant an advance stored order outside those specific source timings. Compulsion stores a fixed world-space direction on its actual application plane. If the target is on another plane at its sole execution opportunity, the direction instruction has no executable route and expires without refund or delayed retry; no universal cross-plane compass relation is invented. Same-plane relocation keeps the recorded world direction, not a new vector to the caster.
currentLiveSharedRules.DE4-NIGHTMARE-ROOT-02: NEW source-specific implementation of the accepted Null root rule. On a failed Phantasmal Killer application with a legally established damage component, create that recipient/application damage root before its first packet and snapshot the actual caster dealer's current unsuppressed Null Veil. The Illusion immediate packet and all later scheduled packets of that application descend from this one root, even if its initial round exposure was already spent and no initial packet resolved. Later Veil changes never rewrite this root. A genuinely new spell application, including a separate Enchantment immediate hit, creates a new root and checks the then-current caster state. Allocating a root is not damage, a hit, a Wound, a kill, a resource event or a claimed periodic exposure. Use actual scheduled recipient lifecycles, death saves and preexisting-source timing; a companion phase is not a new regular turn.
currentLiveSharedRules.DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03: NEW DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03, scoped only to Compulsion: at successful failed-save establishment record one pending instruction, its application order, original timing basis and one finite latest opportunity marker. For a creature with a regular turn schedule, use its next future regular START, excluding a turn already underway. For an owner-attached chassis, use the attached-phase boundary after the next original-owner regular turn that has not begun; record the original regular owner END/attached-phase marker even if an actual phase may be unavailable then. If no such original schedule/marker exists, use application+6 elapsed seconds. These are spell-only timing records, not new creature turns. Preserve the original marker and its virtual elapsed-time mapping through initiative changes, absence, extra turns and relocation. Use at most one qualifying future actual movement opportunity within that window; an attached target can execute only in its real source-authorized original-owner regular attached phase. An already-underway owner turn supplies no newly compelled phase. A genuinely earlier qualifying opportunity after a schedule change can consume the instruction once, with only its actual remaining budget. A later rescheduling cannot carry the instruction past its original finite marker. At the recorded boundary, finish ordinary required START/phase processing before this instruction's sole eligibility/movement check; immediately after that check expire it whether movement was possible, blocked, suppressed or zero. This specifically typed expiry-after-opportunity ordering avoids expiring the instruction before its own simultaneous check; it is not a change to global phase0 duration expiry. When the actual lifecycle supplies no qualifying phase at the recorded boundary, perform an expiry-only bookkeeping check at that original marker and remove the instruction. This check grants no movement, Action, Reaction, recharge, control START, command or owner resource expenditure. An owner-attached target with no original schedule therefore expires at application+6 if no independently supplied lawful phase occurs first. A normal independent creature outside initiative can have the one expressly proposed ordinary movement opportunity by application+6 under the real shared behavior budget; establish initiative before hostile behavior. No phase, target physiology, missing movement mode or new budget is inferred from that fallback. A later repair, owner return, phase creation or suppression ending never replays an expired instruction. This is explicit NEW joint-review authorship, not an already accepted general timing rule.
currentLiveSharedRules.DE4-RNG-05:
NEW DE4-RNG-05 proposal under the owner's video-game-only directive. Authored dice are engine RNG operations, not physical tabletop objects. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. A roll event has an immutable original-event ID, replacement-lineage ID, actual generating entity/local event, original source, stable ordered component IDs, original modifiers/advantage state, target set and source-defined visibility grants. Finish the complete original RNG operation before any of these reroll permissions can commit; commit before its consequences. Fate Coin selects exactly one component of the complete eligible original operation and draws the same die type once; recompute its original reduction/selection with every other component unchanged. Mark Omen and Fate Reversal replace their own complete eligible d20 procedure. These distinctions survive digital implementation.

An engine's knowledge, logging, debug access, animation, a player's camera, knowledge of the seed, or prediction of a hidden outcome grants no character/player permission. The entire original die-result set must already be available to the acting player under the original event's established gameplay-information policy, and the source's actual perception, range, line-of-effect and resource predicates must independently pass. No eligible prompt, selectable event identifier or failure reason may reveal an otherwise hidden event. If the original source has no established visibility grant, these spells grant none; a source-specific presentation decision must be authored separately. A visible summed total alone does not reveal otherwise hidden component faces or grant a one-component choice. A fixed or automatic result with no actual RNG operation supplies no reroll event. Source-defined finite uniform 1dN random draws are eligible for Fate Coin only when their original result set is already available and the other source predicates pass; an empty set creates no draw, and the previously snapshotted candidate set never changes on replacement. Arbitrary simulation RNG, generation seeds and unexposed loot/world generation are not made eligible merely by existing in engine memory. No additional replacement RNG is consumed for a rejected preflight or a paid-but-blocked alteration; record the committed cost and guard separately from whether a new draw occurred.

Serialize legal commitments through the actual gameplay event queue. Simultaneous candidates use current initiative order; ties use stable preexisting actor ID then stable source/application ID. Outside initiative use those stable actor/source IDs fixed before this original event was generated. Network arrival, frame rate, client/UI order, reopening a prompt and a new replacement ID cannot change priority or create a new original lineage. A rejected later candidate spends no Reaction, token or permission. This is a scoped deterministic tie-break for these three spell permissions, not a rewrite of all interrupt priority or any class-specific reroll. Snapshot the original modifiers, including any eligible Alignment Nexus benefit, when the original roll is created; replacement retains those modifiers even if later alignment/ward changes would alter a genuinely new event. Apply only the final original event's consequences once. No additional cast, attack, target rescan, payment, hit, Wound, death event or resource grant is generated by a replacement.

SOURCE POLICY BINDING: DE4-PRESENTATION-06 in this same pending revision supplies only its five explicitly proposed entries. Unlisted events remain denied. Both documents require exact joint acceptance before live application.
currentLiveSharedRules.DE4-PRESENTATION-06:
NEW DE4-PRESENTATION-06 — proposed narrow digital presentation policy for this conference; NOT an already accepted visibility grant. This policy grants only the following event-result presentations. It does not disclose hidden creatures, secret events, source/rank/DC/AC information, hidden modifier reasons, RNG seeds or future draws. An explicit source prohibition on disclosure takes precedence. Unlisted or unclassified events remain unavailable to these three Fate permissions until separately authored; absence of a secrecy tag is not a grant.

1. OVERT-ATTACK: for an actual ordinary Core attack whose generating creature, declared attack and target are already perceived/identified by the reacting creature through its real senses, give that creature's authorized controller the complete resolved original attack d20 set before hit/miss consequences. This is an explicit new result-presentation decision, not a new sensing ability. Display the faces and which original selection rule is being applied, not the hidden causes of advantage, the target's AC or hidden modifiers. A hidden attacker or an unperceived/unknown target does not qualify under this entry. An extra camera, spectator role, battle log or engine access is not perception. An AI controller receives only the corresponding authorized view, not the entire engine state.

2. OWN-REQUESTED-CHECK: an actually requested, nonsecret ordinary ability/skill/tool check presents its complete original d20 set privately to that actor's authorized controller. Automatic/secret sensing checks, protected inquiries and hidden contests are excluded. Another reacting character can use that player's legitimate display only when that reacting character independently satisfies its own actual source perception/range/LoE and resource predicates; this rule grants no character-to-character telepathy. In a multi-character player party, the player may control both actors; a multiplayer peer does not inherit another player's private grant.

3. BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE: once an actual reviewed Burning Hands cone is manifested and the shared 3d6 operation is generated, present the complete shared faces before damage consequences to the caster's controller and to controllers of reacting characters who actually perceive the caster and the manifested cone. This whitelist entry is specifically for the reviewed Burning Hands damage operation, not every damage pool. It reveals no target list, save result, resistance or hidden recipient. Per-recipient damage is still computed once from the one final shared total. A reaction holder must additionally pass its own actual Coin range/LoE/hand/custody predicates. A source-suppressed operation that creates no actual damage draw gives nothing to reroll.

4. CONFUSION-BEHAVIOR: for this pending Confusion procedure, show the actual finite d4 behavior, any genuinely generated d8 direction, and any genuinely generated uniform 1dN perceived-target selection privately to the affected body's authorized controller before that behavior executes. Do not expose candidates that this body cannot actually perceive. Other controllers receive no raw selection results under this entry. A player who also controls a reacting holder can use that legitimate result view only if the reacting holder independently perceives the true roll-generating body and passes Coin's other source requirements. The snapshotted set and candidate order are immutable; an empty set makes no draw. A private NPC-controller view is not disclosed to human players.

5. RESONANCE-WELL-RESERVE: show the actual initial 1d4 reserve-creation draw privately to the Well creator's authorized controller before the reserve is established. This preserves the existing timing boundary but authors its digital display; it does not expose any already-established or hidden reserve and does not permit a later reroll/refill. The reacting holder still needs Coin's real event perception/range/LoE/custody/Reaction.

For these entries only, record policyId, entryId, original event ID, the authorized controller set and the actual perception evidence at generation. Recheck the reacting source's own spatial/resource predicates at commitment. Already lawfully learned original faces are not erased by a later effect, but event knowledge alone never satisfies a currently missing character predicate. Present only information this whitelist actually grants, whether or not any observer possesses a Fate source; resource possession cannot become a detector. Total-only or hidden-result policies remain insufficient. Preserve the original RNG component IDs and reduction rule through replacement. No rejected declaration or paid-but-blocked alteration generates a replacement draw.

This is a minimum concrete policy, not a universal dice-visibility policy. In particular, unlisted enemy saving throws, trauma, secret checks, loot/world generation and private source operations remain unavailable. Future presentation entries require explicit source-specific authorship and separate review. Composition vectors that declare a visibility grant remain composition vectors; that declaration is not evidence that an unlisted live source supplies one.

NEW BURNING-HANDS EVENT-EXISTENCE COMPLETION FOR CONCURRENCE: For this source only, each actually manifested Burning Hands cone generates exactly one complete original shared3d6 operation at its ordinary damage-resolution checkpoint whether the eligible recipient set is empty, entirely hidden, or includes known recipients. It is the same cast operation, not an extra roll, attack or damage packet per recipient. A cast interrupted or prevented before manifestation generates none. A manifested empty cone deals no damage and triggers no hit/damage/Wound/kill/resource consequence, even though its finite original pool is available under BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE. Thus the presence, number, values, availability and timing of the published pool do not encode whether hidden recipients exist. No target list, saves, defenses or damage outcome is added to this presentation. A paid Coin may alter that original empty-cone pool only through its ordinary actual predicates, with its normal consumed item/Reaction/guard and no refunded cost; it creates no recipient or successful damage event. This is explicit NEW per-source RNG-generation authorship, not a rule for other empty areas or unlisted spells.

Concentration maintenance itself remains possible inside; field creation does not cancel remote already-established effects merely because their concentrating caster entered. It suppresses the actual local expression/affected component, not a distant source solely through caster ownership. A creature-attached magical benefit/condition or discrete magical item is wholly suppressed while any of that body/item's actual occupied volume intersects the covered sphere; a large freestanding area/barrier is suppressed only in its actual intersection. A merely overlapping target space does not suppress unrelated creatures elsewhere. Created summons use their source's suppression placement/history rules; real animated bodies become inert only if their actual animation source says so. Magic items retain their mundane body/profile and inventory while their actual magical enhancements/actions are unavailable; intrinsic mundane functions do not vanish. If no ordinary fallback profile exists, do not fabricate one as an extra weapon/armor entitlement. Nonmagical class abilities, learned facts, RP maxima/records, physical injuries, completed ordinary material creation/transmutation, finished teleportation, restoredHP and consumed items are not rolled back. A continuing spell curse is suppressed only in its magical components; a persistent mundane disease or intrinsic nonmagical trait is not automatically cured. A present magical tempHP/buffer grant is unavailable while suppressed but retains its remaining balance and original ending; no damage then absorbed from it, no later refund of HP loss. The ordinary single-grant/strongest-buffer records still apply to another actual accepted grant, with no second hidden usable bank. Suppressing a changed body uses the reviewed body/root/meld/placement rules; it does not clone gear or close-and-recapture its meld set. A legal spell cast may still be committed inside if its ordinary nonmagical casting permissions/components/resources exist: pay full applicable costs and cadence, but suppress its payload before application. Suppressed focus enhancements do not destroy a mundane casting focus. An instantaneous component originating inside, or whose required actual source-to-target/initial-origin path crosses the covered volume, cannot resume that same component beyond the field. A caster outside cannot choose an area center beyond it to bypass an intercepted originating path. Once a persistent source was legally established outside, its later actual origin and local intersection govern: suppress only intersecting portions without retroactively countering the whole old cast. No free list of what failed/which ranks or secret curses is supplied. Leaving/ending suppression restores only still-live permitted expressions, originalHP/buff balances and clocks; missed damage/healing/orders/saves that were unavailable are not queued. Any source that still permits an ending save while suppressed retains it. Ending the field does not refill charges, renew expiries, refund prices or recall dropped gear.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
Action; range 10 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP. Preserve the source's 10-foot sphere and suppression promise. NEW: choose one perceived fixed point within 10 feet and line of effect; create a fixed 10-foot-radius sphere with concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, explicitly replacing the source's insufficient Instantaneous field duration for this authored procedure. The volume is clipped by actual solid total-cover barriers from the center and never follows a creature.

The field suppresses the local expression of actual ongoing spells and explicitly magical nonspell technique expressions only where their real body/effect/anchor intersects the operative volume. It supplies no rank ceiling. It does not retroactively undo completed damage, healing, movement, transmutation, consumed items, permanent ordinary matter, HP loss or source history. It does not erase class engines, learned facts, RP pools, injuries or intrinsic nonmagical traits. A magic item keeps its mundane body/ownership/contents while its magical enhancements/actions are unavailable. A creature-attached spell buff is wholly unavailable while the creature intersects; a large wall/field loses only its intersecting portion unless its own indivisible source says otherwise.

An otherwise legal spell cast may still be committed inside: pay its real final price, Action/components/cadence and concentration transition. If the spell's relevant manifestation originates inside the field, suppress that payload at resolution; there is no queued later release and no refund. Do not invent an imaginary straight-line beam/path for teleportation or nonprojectile magic. For current Dimensional Door, an origin and endpoint both outside the field are unaffected even if a drawn line crosses it; an origin actually inside the field has its spell payload suppressed after legal commitment. A remote ongoing effect outside is not canceled merely because its concentrating caster enters the field.

Ranger Nature's Whisper is an explicitly magical NONSPELL technique. Inside the field its Action+1 RP+Recharge 3 commitment remains a nonspell event; the magical payload/rider is unavailable with no rank, Counterspell window or Nexus/Dampening price. A still-live Nature's Whisper rider on an actor inside the field is unusable while suppressed but its clock continues.

Oracle's Burden prevents generic remove/suspend of the intrinsic Oracle Curse, so this field does not erase or suspend the Curse engine. Curse Manifestation, Tongues and Consumed retain only their own exact suppression/appearance permissions and timers.

Instances of Lesser Antimagic do not suppress one another; overlapping instances form the union of active volumes. This same-family exception only prevents oscillation and grants no ability to cast a new field from inside another without paying/satisfying the new cast, whose payload is itself exempt only because it is this family.

For Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01. For accepted ordinary Banishment, only actual suppression of the application itself invokes its own accepted closure/end rule; merely suppressing its distant caster does not reach the generated cell/application. For Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment, AC5-BANISH-EXT-01 expressly gives the same close-on-actual-suppression behavior.

Suppression never pauses absolute/source clocks and does not bank missed attacks, aura starts, periodic damage, saves or commands. On exit/end, only still-live source expressions resume with the same remaining HP/pools/deadlines. Wall of Force uses its own safe segment-resumption rule.

Repair04 incoming/output completion: use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04. An instantaneous effect cast outside is not immune merely because its source is outside: inspect the actual recipient/area/destination manifestation. Local damage/healing inside is suppressed with no packet/root; an outside-origin Dimensional Door whose destination footprint is inside fails atomically after cost, while outside→outside remains unaffected regardless of an imaginary line. A legal Greater Dispel or exact class Dispel resolves captured termination operations under AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04; the target Antimagic application ignores only its own suppression, while a different Antimagic field can still suppress that termination operation; ordinary Counterspell remains only a cast-time response before the field exists. Spell Preservation’s primary-book anti-destruction remains source-intrinsic even while magical book usability is suppressed.

AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.classification: NEW scope extension only for Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment; ordinary Banishment remains unchanged
reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission
ordinary Banishment custody/separate-creature and mandatory-body-ending rules
BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, copied only for these two AC5 exile applications
notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. Never settle only cargo when another extant identity exists, and never recreate the ended primary.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.intent: Before the printed CHA save record ACCEPT or RESIST exactly as ordinary Banishment. ACCEPT remains voluntary even if the target rolls and fails; RESIST+failed save is forced. For these two AC5 exiles, No Escape blocks ACCEPT because it names voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block because these applications are not teleportation. This is spell-local classification only.

AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

historicalProposalEvidence.procedure: KEEP Action,range10feet and a10-foot sphere suppressing magical effects/spells. NEW10feet is RADIUS, centered on one perceived fixed point within10feet; it does not follow a creature. Concentration up to60seconds explicitly replaces Instantaneous. Its volume is limited by actual solid total-cover barriers from the center; it does not burrow through a closed wall. It has no physical boundary, damage, pressure, air removal or movement restriction. No rank ceiling is proposed: actual eligible spells of any rank and explicitly magical components are suppressed within its covered volume, subject only to genuine source-specific immunity. An artifact, divine title or class name receives no invented exception; an actual written protected-source exception keeps its scope. NEW each instance of this same Lesser Antimagic field is exempt from suppression by this same family, so overlapping fields form the union of their active volumes rather than an oscillating mutual shutdown. This exemption permits maintaining an existing field, not creating new magic from within another already-active field. Independent effects that specifically suppress this field apply by their own rules. Concentration maintenance itself remains possible inside; field creation does not cancel remote already-established effects merely because their concentrating caster entered. It suppresses the actual local expression/affected component, not a distant source solely through caster ownership. A creature-attached magical benefit/condition or discrete magical item is wholly suppressed while any of that body/item's actual occupied volume intersects the covered sphere; a large freestanding area/barrier is suppressed only in its actual intersection. A merely overlapping target space does not suppress unrelated creatures elsewhere. Created summons use their source's suppression placement/history rules; real animated bodies become inert only if their actual animation source says so. Magic items retain their mundane body/profile and inventory while their actual magical enhancements/actions are unavailable; intrinsic mundane functions do not vanish. If no ordinary fallback profile exists, do not fabricate one as an extra weapon/armor entitlement. Nonmagical class abilities, learned facts, RP maxima/records, physical injuries, completed ordinary material creation/transmutation, finished teleportation, restoredHP and consumed items are not rolled back. A continuing spell curse is suppressed only in its magical components; a persistent mundane disease or intrinsic nonmagical trait is not automatically cured. A present magical tempHP/buffer grant is unavailable while suppressed but retains its remaining balance and original ending; no damage then absorbed from it, no later refund of HP loss. The ordinary single-grant/strongest-buffer records still apply to another actual accepted grant, with no second hidden usable bank. Suppressing a changed body uses the reviewed body/root/meld/placement rules; it does not clone gear or close-and-recapture its meld set. A legal spell cast may still be committed inside if its ordinary nonmagical casting permissions/components/resources exist: pay full applicable costs and cadence, but suppress its payload before application. Suppressed focus enhancements do not destroy a mundane casting focus. An instantaneous component originating inside, or whose required actual source-to-target/initial-origin path crosses the covered volume, cannot resume that same component beyond the field. A caster outside cannot choose an area center beyond it to bypass an intercepted originating path. Once a persistent source was legally established outside, its later actual origin and local intersection govern: suppress only intersecting portions without retroactively countering the whole old cast. No free list of what failed/which ranks or secret curses is supplied. Leaving/ending suppression restores only still-live permitted expressions, originalHP/buff balances and clocks; missed damage/healing/orders/saves that were unavailable are not queued. Any source that still permits an ending save while suppressed retains it. Ending the field does not refill charges, renew expiries, refund prices or recall dropped gear.

currentLiveCard.procedure:
Action; range 10 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP. Preserve the source's 10-foot sphere and suppression promise. NEW: choose one perceived fixed point within 10 feet and line of effect; create a fixed 10-foot-radius sphere with concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, explicitly replacing the source's insufficient Instantaneous field duration for this authored procedure. The volume is clipped by actual solid total-cover barriers from the center and never follows a creature.

The field suppresses the local expression of actual ongoing spells and explicitly magical nonspell technique expressions only where their real body/effect/anchor intersects the operative volume. It supplies no rank ceiling. It does not retroactively undo completed damage, healing, movement, transmutation, consumed items, permanent ordinary matter, HP loss or source history. It does not erase class engines, learned facts, RP pools, injuries or intrinsic nonmagical traits. A magic item keeps its mundane body/ownership/contents while its magical enhancements/actions are unavailable. A creature-attached spell buff is wholly unavailable while the creature intersects; a large wall/field loses only its intersecting portion unless its own indivisible source says otherwise.

An otherwise legal spell cast may still be committed inside: pay its real final price, Action/components/cadence and concentration transition. If the spell's relevant manifestation originates inside the field, suppress that payload at resolution; there is no queued later release and no refund. Do not invent an imaginary straight-line beam/path for teleportation or nonprojectile magic. For current Dimensional Door, an origin and endpoint both outside the field are unaffected even if a drawn line crosses it; an origin actually inside the field has its spell payload suppressed after legal commitment. A remote ongoing effect outside is not canceled merely because its concentrating caster enters the field.

Ranger Nature's Whisper is an explicitly magical NONSPELL technique. Inside the field its Action+1 RP+Recharge 3 commitment remains a nonspell event; the magical payload/rider is unavailable with no rank, Counterspell window or Nexus/Dampening price. A still-live Nature's Whisper rider on an actor inside the field is unusable while suppressed but its clock continues.

Oracle's Burden prevents generic remove/suspend of the intrinsic Oracle Curse, so this field does not erase or suspend the Curse engine. Curse Manifestation, Tongues and Consumed retain only their own exact suppression/appearance permissions and timers.

Instances of Lesser Antimagic do not suppress one another; overlapping instances form the union of active volumes. This same-family exception only prevents oscillation and grants no ability to cast a new field from inside another without paying/satisfying the new cast, whose payload is itself exempt only because it is this family.

For Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01. For accepted ordinary Banishment, only actual suppression of the application itself invokes its own accepted closure/end rule; merely suppressing its distant caster does not reach the generated cell/application. For Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment, AC5-BANISH-EXT-01 expressly gives the same close-on-actual-suppression behavior.

Suppression never pauses absolute/source clocks and does not bank missed attacks, aura starts, periodic damage, saves or commands. On exit/end, only still-live source expressions resume with the same remaining HP/pools/deadlines. Wall of Force uses its own safe segment-resumption rule.

Repair04 incoming/output completion: use AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04. An instantaneous effect cast outside is not immune merely because its source is outside: inspect the actual recipient/area/destination manifestation. Local damage/healing inside is suppressed with no packet/root; an outside-origin Dimensional Door whose destination footprint is inside fails atomically after cost, while outside→outside remains unaffected regardless of an imaginary line. A legal Greater Dispel or exact class Dispel resolves captured termination operations under AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04; the target Antimagic application ignores only its own suppression, while a different Antimagic field can still suppress that termination operation; ordinary Counterspell remains only a cast-time response before the field exists. Spell Preservation’s primary-book anti-destruction remains source-intrinsic even while magical book usability is suppressed.
