AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.classification: NEW scope extension only for Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment; ordinary Banishment remains unchanged
reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission
ordinary Banishment custody/separate-creature and mandatory-body-ending rules
BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, copied only for these two AC5 exile applications
notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. Never settle only cargo when another extant identity exists, and never recreate the ended primary.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.intent: Before the printed CHA save record ACCEPT or RESIST exactly as ordinary Banishment. ACCEPT remains voluntary even if the target rolls and fails; RESIST+failed save is forced. For these two AC5 exiles, No Escape blocks ACCEPT because it names voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block because these applications are not teleportation. This is spell-local classification only.

AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.

currentLiveCard.historicalQuestion: Preserve ending MULTIPLE magical effects in30ft RADIUS, Core Action/range30ft/Instantaneous. Separate point-targeting range from area and define complete finite candidates,sight/line of effect,perception or hidden-effect handling,target choice and maximum or all-effect scope explicitly. Supply source-bound dispel rank/DC/check/outcomes rather than borrowing a familiar game. Determine one roll versus separate rolls,order,whole parent versus one recipient/rider and how an ended barrier affects the initial area snapshot. Compare reviewed Dispel Magic,Dispel Resonance and lesser variants. Actual magical sources and separately governed exceptions control eligibility.

historicalProposalEvidence.procedure: KEEP Action,casting-point range30feet,30-foot RADIUS and ending multiple magical effects. NEW choose one perceived center within30feet. At resolution capture every ongoing independently addressable spell-effect application with some actual affected body, discrete effect/anchor or freestanding area portion inside the30-foot sphere and center line of effect, allies included. Hidden actual source data determines eligibility without identifying magic to the caster. Exclude instantaneous completed consequences, innate nonmagical traits, class engines as a whole, permanent magic-item enchantments/body, and expressly nondispellable effects. A nonspell magical component is eligible only when its own actual source explicitly supplies a dispel interface/rank or DC; no guessed rank0 is assigned. For an eligible ordinary spell application of recorded original generating rank0through5, end it automatically. For rank6through9, make one source spellcasting-ability+PB task check per original generating cast at DC10+twice that recorded rank; reuse that check for all captured recipient applications from that same cast. Apply the actual Core task degrees/natural shifts; Success/Critical Success ends each captured eligible application, Failure/Critical Failure ends none from that check, with no extra critical damage. Unknown actual rank without a separate supplied dispel interface is not guessed into eligibility. Same-cast multi-recipient records are individually captured: ending a buff on one recipient does not automatically remove unselected remote recipients or the caster's concentration unless the source's real parent dependency requires it. For a genuinely indivisible wall/field, a reachable intersecting portion selects that one effect, so successful dispelling ends the whole indivisible effect with its ordinary consequences. A selected created summon follows its actual independent-body versus whole-cohort ending procedure, not a fabricated corpse or magic-item destruction rule. A spell-generated ongoing curse can qualify if within this scope and not specially protected; a disease now persisting without an ongoing spell and a curse requiring an explicit special cure do not acquire a dispel permission. The original capture does not expand when a dispelled wall ceases to block center line of effect. An effect that appears later during resolution was not captured. Eligible suppressed but still-present records may be ended if the actual dispel can reach them; the field suppressing this new cast still prevents it where applicable. No countering a pending cast, undoing HP/costs, reclaiming consumed ingredients, erasing permanent ordinary matter, catalog spell removal or diagnostic success report follows. currentLiveCard.procedure:
Action; casting-point range 30 feet; V/S/F; base 10 RP; Instantaneous. Choose one perceived center within 30 feet. At resolution take one immutable snapshot of every ongoing independently addressable magical effect application having an affected body, discrete anchor/object effect, or freestanding area portion inside the 30-foot-radius sphere and center line of effect. Allies are included. Individual effect perception is not required; no numerical cap or selective post-result omission exists.

Eligible ordinary spell applications retain their original generating rank. Rank 0-5 ends automatically. Rank 6-9 requires one check per original generating cast using the caster's actual spellcasting ability + PB against DC 10 + 2×recorded rank. Reuse that one roll for all captured applications from the same generating cast. Apply current Core task degrees/natural shifts. A nonspell magical component is eligible only if its own source explicitly supplies a dispel interface/rank/DC; never assign rank 0 by appearance or RP cost.

Capture is fixed before any endings. If a captured Wall of Force ends and reveals another effect behind it, that effect is not added. A captured indivisible wall/field ends as one effect on successful/automatic dispel; recipient-specific applications from one cast end only where captured unless their real parent dependency says ending one ends all. Suppressed-but-still-existing records can be dispelled if this cast itself can reach them. Completed instantaneous consequences, permanent matter, class engines, permanent item enchantments and explicitly nondispellable effects are outside scope.

This is distinct from Wizard class Dispel Magic `/cards/19`: that class spell costs 3 RP, range 60, Recharge 2, auto through rank 3, and uses INT+PB vs DC 10+rank above 3. Sigil Authority `/cards/22` names Counterspell and Dispel Magic only and does not modify Greater Dispel. Xi remains its own consent-based branch-ending source and grants no Greater Dispel permission.
newScopedAuthorship: rank0-5 automatic; rank6-9 one shared check per generating cast at DC10+2rank
nonspell only with explicit dispel interface

AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.

AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.classification: NEW extension limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion; does not alter AC4 Water Pet/Envoy scope
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.rule: While either AC5 finite summoned body actually exists, treat it mechanically as an active creature and as a living ally for ordinary HP-healing/living-creature targeting, including Cleric Healing Rite. This does not establish natural biology, native plane, soul, corpse, breeding, nourishment, faction personhood or loot. A Null Disabled 0 body remains the same target while its original source persists and can be legally healed above 0. If the source has already ended/expired/replaced/dismissed the body, there is no target to heal.
AC5-SUMMON-TARGET-01.nullLifecycle: Bind both profiles to the accepted finiteSummonFamiliarMirrorBeast Null recipient branch: qualifying Null damage to 0 replaces only damage-caused disappearance with Disabled 0 while original source duration persists; later qualifying Null hits do not create organic death/Wounds; independent expiry/dismissal/concentration/replacement still ends the body. Ordinary non-Null damage reaching 0 uses the body's normal finite-summon disappearance.

AC5-ROOT-01.classification: NEW AC5 damage-root checkpoints consistent with accepted Null root ownership
AC5-ROOT-01.livingMagma: On a failed initial CON save that successfully establishes the recurring Living Magma rider, create one damage root immediately even though no initial damage packet occurs. Dealer is the caster. Record the caster's then-current unsuppressed Null Veil flag on that root. The three later tick packets are descendants and inherit the creation-time flag; later Veil changes do not rewrite it. A suppressed scheduled tick creates no child packet and is consumed with no makeup.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAttack: Each commanded Fire Pet attack that reaches its actual damage checkpoint creates a distinct root with dealer = Fire Pet body, not owner/controller.
AC5-ROOT-01.greaterFirePetAura: Each qualifying recipient's aura START checkpoint creates its own damage root with dealer = Fire Pet body. One shared d6 roll may feed several recipients but does not merge root identity or copy another actor's Veil. Evaluate the pet body's own Veil at each recipient root creation.
AC5-ROOT-01.massiveBlast: At instantaneous damage resolution create one root per original recipient, all with dealer = caster and the same cast ID. A shared 5d8 roll does not merge recipient roots.
AC5-ROOT-01.barrier: Damage prevention creates no damage root.

AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.classification: NEW scope extension only for Banish Elemental and Elemental Banishment; ordinary Banishment remains unchanged
reuse: BAN-ADMIT-03 current-space preflight, internal creation and legal visitor admission
ordinary Banishment custody/separate-creature and mandatory-body-ending rules
BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 planar/extradimensional nonteleport classification, copied only for these two AC5 exile applications
notReused: ordinary Banishment concentration when the AC5 spell authors another duration
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.suppression: Actual suppression of the exile application closes/ends that application through reused closure; it never pauses and resumes exile.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.bodySourceEnding: If the primary finite creature source ends first, that body ends under its source, then the AC5 exile immediately closes. BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining extant independently legal secondary body/corpse/object once; ended/absent bodies remain absent. Never settle only cargo when another extant identity exists, and never recreate the ended primary.
AC5-BANISH-EXT-01.intent: Before the printed CHA save record ACCEPT or RESIST exactly as ordinary Banishment. ACCEPT remains voluntary even if the target rolls and fails; RESIST+failed save is forced. For these two AC5 exiles, No Escape blocks ACCEPT because it names voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block because these applications are not teleportation. This is spell-local classification only.

AC5-PLANAR-META-01.classification: NEW spell/campaign metadata for Planar Protection, Planar Binding and Alignment Portal only; not a master cosmology
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.planeKey: An opaque stable ID for an actual plane record already established by campaign/source authority. The key carries no automatic alignment, deity, native-species, soul-destination, Wheel, dominion or tributary meaning.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.siteId: A stable known physical destination site on one planeKey with actual location/footprint/support data.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.travelProvenance: On a successful cross-plane body transition using a reviewed source, the Director may record currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = the actual origin planeKey and the transport event ID. A creation source may instead explicitly provide createdFromPlaneKey. These are operational travel/source provenance only and do not establish native origin or soul identity.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.unknown: If a required planeKey/provenance fact is not established, it remains Indeterminate. Spells do not secretly discover or fabricate it.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.prospectiveArrival: For a particular cross-plane transition, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey = the actual planeKey containing the body immediately before that transit. Destination-side Planar Protection and other arrival predicates evaluate this immutable prospective value before placement. Only a successful atomic transition commits currentBody.lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey and the event ID. Failed/countered/blocked transit leaves prior provenance unchanged. createdFromPlaneKey remains creation provenance and is used for ordinary physical ward entry only when no current cross-plane transition supplies a prospective origin.
AC5-PLANAR-META-01.partialFootprint: A destination/entry is ward-eligible if any part of the body/group terminal footprint would enter the protected sphere. All bodies in one carried/group transit are checked independently before atomic placement.

AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.classification: NEW Faction Champion source-specific 'allied faction' gate
AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01.rule: Before payment choose one canonical factionId. Formation requires: (1) an actual spell-specific alliedStatus=true record for this caster/faction; (2) current standing > 0; (3) actual invocation permission under the current faction system; and (4) no explicit aid prohibition. Membership remains a separate credential and is not inferred from alliedStatus or standing. Faction Ally's membership+permission gate and Faction Portal's positive-standing+known-HQ gate remain distinct and are not imported.

AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.classification: NEW Alignment Portal-specific compatibility metadata, not objective plane taxonomy
AC5-ALIGN-PORTAL-META-01.rule: An actual plane record may carry alignmentPortalCompatibility = a set of canonical nine-point alignment keys and one or more known Alignment-Portal siteIds. This is travel compatibility for this spell only. It does not assert that the plane is objectively 'Lawful Good', that a mortal Wheel label equals it, that inhabitants are native there, or that souls/deities map to it.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.classification: NEW suppression profile limited to Greater Fire Pet and Faction Champion
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-SUMMON-01.rule: While any part of one of these bodies intersects operative Lesser Antimagic, keep the same body identity, HP, source deadline, Null Disabled state and genuine cargo. Speed becomes 0 and the body cannot take Actions, companion commands, attacks or Fire-Pet aura checkpoints. Intrinsic manifested gear grants no separate function while suppressed. Genuine carried items remain the same items; if actual physical custody becomes impossible under ordinary item rules, place/drop them normally. Leaving suppression restores only still-live source permissions with the same HP/deadline and no refill/resummon.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.classification: NEW Lesser Antimagic input/output checkpoints and protected-book interpretation; scoped only to this AC5 field
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve normally before suppression.
For an ongoing expression, suppress each local body/anchor/area portion that intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, evaluate its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. Any local payload that would manifest inside the operative field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing inside creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation with a destination footprint intersecting the field fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside teleport/nonpath travel is unaffected even if an imaginary straight line crosses the sphere.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. A genuine projectile/path that physically enters the field follows its own physical/magical source semantics.

An exact dispel effect whose selected target is the Lesser Antimagic application itself may address/end that field without being suppressed solely by the target field. It still needs its own legal source, cost, perception/range/LoE/check. Another separate Antimagic field can suppress the dispeller normally. This narrow self-dispel exception prevents an oscillating indispellable field and grants no passage to unrelated effects.

Wizard Spell Preservation: Antimagic may suppress magical spellbook usability/access effects while intersecting, but it does not erase the permanent class-source fact that the primary spellbook cannot be destroyed/erased/rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. Suppression therefore does not create a window for permanent ordinary destruction. Artifact-level exceptions remain source-governed.
AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03.status: superseded by AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04 for current Repair04 operation semantics

AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.classification: NEW AC5 prospective-arrival provenance timing; operational metadata only
AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03.rule: For every cross-plane transit into a Planar Protection destination, snapshot prospectiveOriginPlaneKey from the body’s actual plane immediately before the transit. Evaluate the destination ward against that value before placement, regardless of stale lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. On success commit lastArrivedFromPlaneKey=prospective origin; on failure keep the prior record unchanged. No failure reveals hidden provenance/cosmology beyond ordinary observed failure.

rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose is chosen in a perceived clear supported space within60/LoE. Destination site metadata must already provide one known portalPose with clear supported 5-by-5 staging space on each side; missing pose/clearance makes the cast illegal rather than allowing remote tactical placement.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. A voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional travel through a physical gateway and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering the aperture costs 5 feet of base ordinary movement. Apply actual terrain, crawling and squeezing costs to that 5-foot traversal. A Large body may use a 5-foot aperture only if ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze is legal; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and its real penalties. Carried creatures are separate bodies and all members of one packet must fit/support and pass arrival blockers.

Forced movement may carry a body through only if the forcing source supplies enough real movement/path and the body/group passes all arrival gates. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement budget and does not become voluntary travel; No Escape therefore does not block the forced crossing merely by its voluntary wording.

Crossing maps the traveler’s facing relative to the entry normal to the corresponding destination exit normal. Destination placement is the nearest fitting unoccupied supported space touching the exit staging side, using fixed neutral board order for ties. No search through barriers and no body bisection.
AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03.status: superseded by AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04 for current Repair04 formation/crossing semantics

AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.classification: NEW Wall of Force resumption geometry only
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by2.5-foot logical panels (edge remainders keep their exact smaller size). Antimagic suppresses the intersecting panel portions. On resumption, each panel/portion returns only if its 1-inch volume is clear. Occupied portions stay absent until clear; no push, cut, crush, arbitrary tactical hole or free squeeze is created. Once clear, the exact fixed portion resumes.
AC5-WALL-PANELS-03.status: superseded by AC5-WALL-PANELS-04 for current Repair04 resumption semantics

AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03.rule: Planar Protection supplies no support. If an eligible creature’s continuous ordinary Falling would cross inward and the last exterior boundary point is unsupported, the ward does not arrest or suspend that Fall Marker; the continuous fall may carry the body inside. Once inside, it is treated as already inside for this ward and may leave but cannot reenter after leaving while still eligible. Grounded/otherwise supported forced or voluntary crossings remain blocked at the last legal exterior position.

AC5-BINDING-ORDER-03.classification: NEW Planar Binding pending-order lifecycle only
rule: Each live binder→target record holds at most one pending service order. Issuance requires the binder and target on the same plane, a valid one-way command-intent channel, the binder’s real Bonus Action in initiative or one order opportunity per6 elapsed seconds outside initiative, and a currently source-legal simple order. Invalid issuance spends no order record; normal action-cost commitment follows the actual declaration rules.

A valid order receives its issue timestamp and binds the target’s next regular behavior opportunity after issue: next regular target turn/opportunity in initiative, or next six-second behavior pulse outside initiative. It expires at the end of that one opportunity whether executed, impossible, suppressed or budget-starved. No order is banked/replayed.

A later valid Binding order from the same binder before execution replaces that binder’s older pending Binding order; it does not erase other control effects. Plane change after a valid order does not erase the already-heard instruction, but plane separation prevents new issuance. Lesser Antimagic suppressing the Binding compulsion at the execution opportunity makes that order ineffective for the opportunity and it expires; the 24-hour service clock continues.

Companion/source gates remain prerequisites. Binding never creates the owner’s Companion Command, Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or offense token. If an owner legally opens one commanded companion damaging action and a pending Binding Attack order is compatible with that action but conflicts only on target choice, use Compelled Budget Arbitration/priority to constrain the one available action. If no source-gated action becomes available during the bound opportunity, the order expires without inventing one.

AC5-BARRIER-RECAST-03.classification: NEW Resonance Barrier same-name application/concentration lifecycle clarification
rule: Ordinary concentration transition occurs at the new cast’s legal commitment before Counterspell or fresh Barrier formation. Therefore a same-caster old Barrier that depended on that caster’s concentration ends at commitment and cannot survive a countered, failed, zero-pool or weaker replacement cast unless a future exact source expressly grants that exception.

If a still-live Barrier from a different caster protects the target, compare the fresh offered pool only at successful resolution. Stronger fresh pool replaces the retained application and ends the old Barrier application/concentration. Equal or weaker fresh offer does not replace/refresh the retained pool; the fresh Barrier application ends immediately at resolution and its new caster’s concentration on that application ends, with no refund.
Pool comparisons use remaining retained pool versus fresh offered initial pool. No two pools add.

AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Lesser Antimagic input/output and dispel-operation capture; supersedes AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-03 where inconsistent
rule: At legal spell/effect commitment, actual costs/components/concentration/cadence resolve before suppression. Ongoing local expressions remain suppressed only where their real body/anchor/area intersects the operative field.

For an instantaneous spell or magical nonspell originating outside, inspect its actual recipient, affected area and/or destination manifestation checkpoint. A local payload that would manifest in the field is suppressed at resolution. Damage/healing there creates no packet/root/rider; an indivisible relocation whose destination footprint intersects fails atomically at origin. Outside-to-outside nonpath travel is unaffected by an imaginary line through the sphere.

For Greater Dispel or another exact multi-effect dispel, first capture the immutable effect set under that source, then snapshot whether each individual captured termination operation is locally suppressed before performing any removal. A termination operation targeting one Lesser Antimagic application ignores suppression from that same target field only. Another independently active Antimagic field may still suppress that termination operation if its operative volume covers the relevant application/operation locus.

Do not re-evaluate a captured termination operation after earlier removals in the same dispel. Thus an inside captured buff whose termination operation was suppressed at the operation snapshot remains live even if the Antimagic field suppressing that operation is ended by another captured operation. There is no second scan or spring-back termination.
This self-dispel exception is operation-local. It neither makes unrelated payloads immune to Antimagic nor lets a dispeller ignore a different suppressing field.
No fictional projectile/path is invented for nonprojectile effects. Genuine projectiles/paths retain their source semantics.

Wizard Spell Preservation remains an intrinsic class protection of the primary spellbook: field suppression can make magical use/access unavailable locally but cannot create a non-artifact ordinary destruction loophole.

AC5-WALL-PANELS-04.classification: NEW Repair04 Wall of Force suppression/resumption geometry; supersedes AC5-WALL-PANELS-03 where inconsistent
rule: Tessellate the authored wall from its fixed lower-left/local anchor into 2.5-foot by 2.5-foot logical panels; exact edge remainders keep their smaller size.

While Antimagic or another exact suppressor overlaps the wall, suppress only the exact intersecting portion of each fixed panel and record that suppressed portion geometry. A portion of a panel that was not suppressed remains solid and cannot be entered merely because another portion is absent.

When suppression ends, process each recorded suppressed portion at its original fixed coordinates. If any part of that recorded portion's 1-inch wall volume intersects a creature or independent object, hold that entire recorded suppressed portion absent until clear. Do not generate a new body-shaped cutout and do not deactivate neighboring wall portions that remained solid.
Once the recorded portion is clear, that exact portion resumes. No push, cut, crush, tactical hole selection, free squeeze or movement is created.

AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-04.classification: NEW Repair04 refinement of Alignment Portal physical aperture/crossing; supersedes AC5-PORTAL-GEOMETRY-03 where inconsistent
rule: Alignment Portal creates two fixed linked vertical apertures, each 5 feet wide by 8 feet high. At cast time record each aperture base-center, floor elevation and outward normal. Origin pose must be perceived, clear and supported within 60 feet/LoE. Destination site metadata must already supply a known portalPose with clear supported staging space sufficient for the intended known portal opening; portal creation itself transports no body or object.

A current Dimensional Anchor does not prevent the linked apertures from forming. Anchor is checked on each actual planar-transition transaction whose transported origin or destination footprint intersects the field; a known blocked crossing commits no movement, while a blocker appearing after legal crossing commitment yields atomic failure at origin under accepted Anchor.

The gateway is bidirectional while active. Voluntary crossing is planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel and is NOT teleportation. No Escape blocks voluntary crossing; Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not. This classification is Alignment-Portal-only.

Entering an aperture requires 5 feet of actual path through the gateway and ordinarily costs 5 feet of base movement. Use the accepted additive per-foot cost: terrain rate1 normal,2 difficult or3 severe (strongest terrain only), then add1 for crawling and1 for squeezing. A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. A Large 10x10 body may use ordinary one-size-smaller squeeze only when its stated height/pose and the actual aperture permit it; squeezing adds +1 movement cost per foot and keeps its real penalties.

Forced movement may cross only when the forcing source itself supplies a legal path and enough actual forced distance through the aperture. Do not infer that a Shove can force a body through a squeeze it could not otherwise physically clear. A fitting Medium body successfully Shoved 5 feet directly through the aperture is a sufficient forced-crossing fixture; forced movement is not voluntary, so No Escape's voluntary wording does not block that transit. All arrival gates still apply.

Crossing maps facing relative to entry normal to destination exit normal. Destination placement must fit the whole body in the actual supported staging space; fixed neutral board order breaks equivalent placements. No search through barriers and no body bisection.

operational.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range and line of effect, including yourself.
operational.duration: 1 hour: expires 3,600 elapsed seconds after application; entering, leaving or reordering initiative does not change that deadline.
operational.resolution: Automatic after legal casting. Check an information-gathering effect's actual generating source classification, using its real casting-class school placement where applicable.
operational.effect: The target supplies no new information to effects explicitly classified as Divination or Scrying that attempt to perceive, locate, inspect, read, identify or otherwise obtain information about it. Apply this protection equally against hostile, neutral and beneficial information gathering. A multi-subject or area effect may still obtain permitted information about other subjects.
operational.limitations: No ordinary invisibility, concealment, false identity, attack defense, memory erasure, record deletion or retroactive protection. A class sense is blocked only insofar as its actual source classifies it as Divination/Scrying; the underlying class engine remains intact. Theme or guessed purpose is not classification. Known information remains known. Independent applications do not stack extra power and each retains its own endpoint. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and divination/scrying immunity. NEW CONFLICT RULING: ongoing 1 hour without concentration replaces Instantaneous metadata; immunity is operationally defined as prevention of new information about one willing target, not a blanket damage/benefit immunity against a school name.

operational.targets: One willing creature you can perceive within range and line of effect, including yourself.
operational.duration: 1 hour: expires 3,600 elapsed seconds after application; entering, leaving or reordering initiative does not change that deadline.
operational.resolution: Automatic after legal casting. Check an information-gathering effect's actual generating source classification, using its real casting-class school placement where applicable.
operational.effect: The target supplies no new information to effects explicitly classified as Divination or Scrying that attempt to perceive, locate, inspect, read, identify or otherwise obtain information about it. Apply this protection equally against hostile, neutral and beneficial information gathering. A multi-subject or area effect may still obtain permitted information about other subjects.
operational.limitations: No ordinary invisibility, concealment, false identity, attack defense, memory erasure, record deletion or retroactive protection. A class sense is blocked only insofar as its actual source classifies it as Divination/Scrying; the underlying class engine remains intact. Theme or guessed purpose is not classification. Known information remains known. Independent applications do not stack extra power and each retains its own endpoint. Apply SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md for actual class access and repertoire, costs before resolution, components, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and exact source cadence. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and divination/scrying immunity. NEW CONFLICT RULING: ongoing 1 hour without concentration replaces Instantaneous metadata; immunity is operationally defined as prevention of new information about one willing target, not a blanket damage/benefit immunity against a school name.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime and balance validation pending

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: All four actual Core rows are Action/120feet/V,S,F/rank8/base21RP. Only Mass Dominate prints concentration up to1minute; the other three print Instantaneous. All three Enchantments are Wizard15 only; Mind Ravel is Cleric15/Wizard15 Divination.
options: Inherit exact current access, ordinary casting, hidden eligibility, binary saves, hard-control and component-specific defenses; explicitly author only missing per-card behavior.
Specify a concrete conflicting source before changing an inherited contract.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Use exact inherited contracts and preserve every native promise. No external-game stat block, auto alias, added damage, creature-type immunity, generic Charmed tag or class access.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Erase all short-term memory of an event; the source defines neither event boundaries nor lookback.
options: Select one actual experienced continuous event segment, maximum5minutes, ending within the prior elapsed hour; declare its time interval/known description without reading hidden memory.
Use a narrower at-most60second event segment within the preceding5minutes, or specify another exact source-scoped bound.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer the first as explicit NEW finite episodic scope, subject to actual GPT concurrence. Keep exact endpoints and failure for absent/unknown qualifying experience private; no invented sensory readout or arbitrary lifetime erasure.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core Instantaneous does not say whether missing recall returns or leaves an ongoing magical record.
options: Completed firsthand episodic loss, retaining provenance and allowing later new knowledge; no surviving magical suppression/dispel target.
A continuing magical inaccessibility layer with an explicit finite lifetime and defined suppression/removal behavior.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer completed loss consistent with Instantaneous and actual Disrupt Memory, without extending that card or importing pending memory2 recovery. Any future source restoring firsthand recall must expressly qualify.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Identity shaken is printed, but no native condition or duration is named.
options: Explicit NEW source-scoped soft disadvantage on the next WIS ability check begun within60seconds; one entitlement, consumed even if advantage cancels, never a save or ordinary action denial.
Specify another finite measurable identity-pressure rider that preserves the printed benefit without assigning a cosmological track, personality or unrelated condition.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer one finite soft entitlement. Resolve same/different-caster overlap without refresh farming. Do not add Unity Exposure, alignment shifts, belief/loyalty changes, Stunned, language loss or permanent identity deletion.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: One printed WIS resistance covers memory loss and an unspecified identity rider; independent defenses may cover only one.
options: One initial WIS save; on failure independently attempt both printed components through actual defenses. Successful save gives neither. Keep the ongoing soft rider distinct from completed memory change.
Author a materially different admission split with explicit rationale and no duplicate unintended initial saves.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer one admission save with component-specific effects. Memory protection need not block the soft rider; broad mental immunity only covers its actual scope. Removing a rider cannot undo the prior world or erase spent resources.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The native row fixes INT/CHA to1 and forbids spells/communication, but specifies no initial save.
options: Explicit NEW INT initial save; success prevents all attempted components, failure applies actual eligible components.
Choose WIS initial resistance or automatic application, with a specific consequence/rationale.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer INT as a proposed local resistance, not a recovered rule. No psychic damage or external30-day recovery is supplied. Separate known illegal targeting from hidden mental defense.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core Instantaneous conflicts with unspecified persistence of the score and capability restrictions.
options: Explicit NEW ongoing nonconcentration effect for24hours, removable/suppressible only through actually applicable sources; restore lawful underlying state on end.
Keep instantaneous lasting change with a separately defined native recovery mechanism, or choose another explicit bounded duration.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer the first only as a declared source-duration completion, preserving its full printed effects for the chosen term. Do not borrow an absent Greater Restoration spell or claim numerical balance approval.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: INT and CHA are scores, not modifiers; underlying score progression and capacity rules remain actual.
options: An effective score-setting layer makes both1 while active, retaining underlying changes and other source histories. Actual formulas read effective modifiers where their own timing requires; preparation/repertoire records are not erased retroactively.
Apply permanent direct score replacement or define a different layer priority, with complete restoration and overlap consequences.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer an explicit local setting layer. Decide ordering versus transformations/other score setters and suppression resume; do not assume every derived capacity is continuously recalculated or fabricate refunds, restored charges, new preparation slots or RP loss.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Cannot cast spells or communicate is broader than Silence; it does not print Incapacitated or unconsciousness.
options: Block actual spell activations from all otherwise legal routes and intentional outgoing linguistic/semantic communication through voice, writing, signing or telepathy; retain ordinary recognition, choices, physical actions and incoming perception/comprehension unless expressly restricted.
Also suppress comprehension or selected nonspell mental features, with exact individually justified additions and retained agency.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer the narrower literal capability prohibitions. Decide innate/item/class spell routes, already readied release and ongoing concentration separately; a spellcasting ban alone is not automatic Incapacitated. Incidental sounds/motion and private player UI are not a blanket world-information oracle.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Loss of ordinary spells/communication and low mental scores interact with hard-denial classification and actual controller prerequisites.
options: Classify each component explicitly; do not consume the whole-Action guard merely for a specific capability ban, while any newly added compulsory/action-denial component must use the shared guard. Apply actual INT6+ device-controller prerequisites only at their source-defined checkpoints.
Treat the whole Feeblemind application as hard denial, explicitly settling which printed components can establish when the guard is already spent.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Require actual concurrence on this consequential classification. Retain nonspell abilities unless their own actual predicate fails; do not invent generic attack/turn loss, telepathic reach or retroactive unbinding of every device.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Control up to3 creatures of CR10 or less; actual source prints no level-to-CR conversion.
options: Snapshot one to three distinct perceived creatures at commitment; check actual recorded CR<=10 at application only. No late replacement/enrollment within that cast.
Allow separately priced or bounded later target substitution with a fully specified new permission.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer fixed snapshot. Missing/unreviewed CR stays ineligible/unresolved, not assumed0 or class level. Preserve actual fractional CR. Identity-preserving transformation does not invent a fresh rating; decide whether later CR change affects an established rider.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: WIS save each turn and concentration minute require exact initial/admission and repeat scheduling.
options: One initial WIS per target, then every affected target regular END; extra turns grant no extra saves. Extend the accepted attached-companion/end-save bridge to this card only.
Use each affected regular START instead, specifying whether escape happens before any commanded behavior and how the current turn is treated.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer actual Dominate Person timing with explicit new source binding; retain the source minute and real Wizard Enchantment extension only where its existing scope qualifies. Outside initiative define actual6second cadence and preserved markers.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Control lacks a command channel, costs, controlled action budget and permitted resources.
options: Explicitly extend Dominate Person bounded ordinary movement/Action/free-interaction and same-plane conscious one-way mental orders, independently for each admitted target; no secret knowledge, remote senses, finite optional expenditure or extra turn.
Require actual audible understood orders and a stated shared command budget, preserving the full three-target benefit.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer the reviewed bounded control interface with a clearly named source extension. Specify per-target order issuance, actual budget conflicts and companion original-owner limits; no unwilling owner Bonus Action or offense reservation is manufactured.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Three targets and other sources can compete for control without changing their real budgets.
options: Each genuinely established hard component spends that caster/target/encounter guard once. Retain one Mass Dominate controller per target; genuine same-spell replacement ends only the old component, while other sources use accepted instruction priority.
Define a different same-spell coexistence rule with deterministic arbitration and no capacity multiplication.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer existing scoped pattern with independent target records and stable commitment order. Saved/immune/guard-blocked attempts replace nothing; normal same-caster new concentration still ends old concentration at commitment.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source supplies no damage-release clause or maintained-range tether.
options: Do not invent either; actual concentration, repeat saves, expiry, removal, suppression and expressly qualifying defenses control. End-save cleanup never deletes a later application.
Add a harm-ending or maintained-range limitation only as an explicit NEW rule, explaining its effect on the printed control.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer literal retention. Initial prevention does not queue later establishment; later suppression retains clock and guard history, and ordinary agency returns only within remaining actual restrictions.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Printed forgetting of the last5minutes has exact elapsed scope but no selected-event or readout permission.
options: Remove firsthand episodic recall from resolutionTime-300seconds through resolutionTime, retaining real event identity, prior edits and all world/action/resource state.
Use a different endpoint convention only if stated exactly, without extending the five-minute window.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer resolution-relative elapsed time, with explicit half-open boundaries. Later recollection of older events is not a route to erase the older event; later independent learning is new knowledge, not restored firsthand recall.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Confusion is named but no table, lifetime or ongoing saves are supplied.
options: Explicitly bind the actual reviewed Confusion behavior/RNG/order bridge for this one creature, as a NEW60second nonconcentration component with regular-END WIS escape; no second initial save.
Author a different bounded soft confusion rider, preserving its printed effect and explaining why it differs from actual Confusion.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer explicit native reuse, not an external random table. Actual hard establishment consumes the shared guard once; target/direction RNG remains private unless an actual accepted presentation applies. Do not grant a sixth Fate information channel.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source combines memory and confusion under one WIS save and Instantaneous metadata.
options: One initial WIS gates both; then each component uses its own defenses. A hard-guard block prevents only confusion, while the separately printed memory payload can still occur. Later confusion escape cannot undo completed memory loss.
Tie both effects to an ongoing application and explicitly replace the Instantaneous/source semantics with defined recovery.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer distinct instantaneous loss and declared timed confusion. Memory-only protection does not cure confusion, and losing access to memories does not itself clear concentration or hard-control history.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No recovery source is printed for five-minute forgetting; pending memory2 contains unaccepted new recovery tasks.
options: No generic mundane restoration; actual qualified future repair may restore only its express scope. Witnesses/records can teach new facts, and overlap retains each source/event lineage.
Explicitly extend a newly agreed memory-family recovery procedure after that separate conference, with exact event intersections and highest-DC/layer handling.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer preserve the distinction now. Pending Woven/Haze choices and the accepted six-second Disrupt Memory cannot silently be extended to this spell or Erase Mind.

If a required CR profile or event source is absent, preserve the whole conditional case and report the exact missing content instead of inventing it.

Include real Wizard15 and Cleric15 providers, actual CR evidence for Mass Dominate, independent memory/guard/communication defenses, score1 negative-modifier arithmetic and no resource reset. sourceFindings: Erase Mind event/lookback and identity rider remain undefined; no full-world history erasure is printed.
Feeblemind fixes actual INT/CHA scores to 1, not modifiers. No initial save or named recovery is printed; reconcile its Instantaneous metadata with continuing restrictions.
Mass Dominate keeps up to 3 actual CR<=10 creatures, WIS each turn and concentration for 1 minute; no guessed class-level-to-CR conversion or new finite-resource control.
Mind Ravel has an exact last-5-minute memory scope and WIS save, but no operational confusion lifetime; memory and control defenses/ending need separate treatment.

Disrupt Memory is accepted instantaneous firsthand loss with world-state preservation. Memory/Creation3 has now accepted and applied Woven Threads/Haze of Forgetting; use only its exact received scope and do not generalize recovery.
Actual Dominate Person and Confusion complete native procedures and RNG/presentation scopes are supplied. Any extension requires a specific per-card decision.
Wizard prepared matrices, negative actual modifiers, and Tinker controller prerequisites retain actual source timing; score changes are not automatic repertoire erasure or resource refunds.
Identity shaken is not a Unity Exposure, Corruption, alignment, or cosmological identity change. No cosmology decision is made.
Memory/Creation3, Control15, Companion/Life10, Rank8 Control5, and Rank8 Ward5 are accepted and applied comparison groups. Their current receipts/models are included; none remains pending.
futureCaseRequirements: At least two full deterministic cases per identity after choices, plus explicit independent branches for each consequential completion.

Erase Mind:known interval/unknown contents, event boundaries, overlap, later recalled older event, independent memory/rider protection, identity entitlement consumption and no world/resource rollback.

Feeblemind:actual score1/negative modifier, lawful underlying progression and competing score layers, Wizard preparation/cast/Ready/concentration timing, outgoing versus incoming communication, explicit device prerequisites, suppression and expiry without reset.

Mass Dominate:three distinct actual CR-qualified targets with separate saves/guards, real clocks, initial/current-turn timing, source-qualified companion budgets, instruction arbitration, failed replacement versus concentration commitment and independent cleanup.

Mind Ravel:real300second interval, private native confusion RNG, no initial duplicate save, independent hard-guard/memory defenses, confusion escape not memory restoration, no false memories or sixth DE4 presentation.
Hold any case whose required creature rating or event source remains absent; do not invent a profile or turn a conditional case into completed content.
